title: Trump's Disclosure-Integrity Exposure Remained Auditable Through AP's Missing-File Metric
description_short: Trump's Disclosure-Integrity Exposure Remained Auditable Through AP's Missing-File Metric
description_medium: An Associated Press headline dated December 20, 2025, reported that at least 16 Jeffrey Epstein-related files had disappeared from a Justice Department webpage. The article itself returned an access error, so the available material does not identify the files, when each disappeared or returned, or what the department said about the changes.

notes: The linked AP article returned HTTP 403. Its headline reports at least 16 missing DOJ webpage files; no file-by-file chronology, removal or restoration dates, handling records, or DOJ explanation could be read.
